commit.message: fix(onboarding): restore canonical NATS substrate status

interface_mismatches: The canonical NATS substrate spec requires make onboard to render NATS status every session, but exact-base compact human and --json output carry no NATS projection.
The legacy onboarding implementation referenced the NATS spec, but compact onboarding migration PR #913 removed that surface while the hard governance invariant remained canonical.
honest_blockers: A listening TCP port proves only that a local listener accepted a connection. This packet cannot claim NATS protocol health, JetStream acknowledgement, agent reachability, or live contact.
Compatibility filesystem mirror presence is evidence of paths only and must remain explicitly false as live-transport proof.
WP-0E remains a separate draft and must rebase after this prerequisite lands; this packet does not edit or promote WP-0E.
Hosted exact-head CI, independent review, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the compact onboarding compatibility shim, the four compact onboarding implementation files, the two focused test files, and this exact packet together. Rollback restores the known canonical gap: make onboard no longer renders the NATS substrate section. Do not replace the projection with live evidence or alter onboarding verdict semantics during rollback.
